description.zh:
网站业务的域名。
> 域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有域名。
description.en:
The domain name of your website.

> A website forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS instance belongs in Resource Management. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询适用于当前域名的所有证书列表

descriptions.zh:
该接口为查询配置高防域名适用所有证书，会出现一个域名对应多个证书。例如：通过精准域名查询到精准域名证书或泛域名证书。
> 如果您需要查询当前域名正在生效使用的证书您可以调用[DescribeWebRules](~~473610~~)查询获取CertName和CertRegion，然后调用证书中心的接口[ListUserCertificateOrder](~~411733~~)使用返回的CertName关联查询到对应的证书ID或其他详情。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query all certificates that are available for a domain name protected by an Anti-DDoS instance. A domain name can be associated with multiple certificates. For example, a query for a specific domain name can return both a certificate for that specific domain name and a wildcard certificate.

> To query the certificate that is currently used by a domain name, call the [DescribeWebRules](~~473610~~) operation to obtain the CertName and CertRegion values. Then, call the [ListUserCertificateOrder](~~411733~~) operation of Certificate Management Service. Use the returned CertName value to query the corresponding certificate ID and other details.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-certs --resource-group-id default --domain www.aliyun.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
